topics.titleEn: Vite, Turbopack, Rspack: The 2026 Bundler Fight
topics.angle: comparison + build speeds, DX and migration paths
topics.brief: Data-led comparison of 2026 frontend build tools. Sections: the shift from webpack to Rust/Go-powered bundlers; Vite (and Rolldown), Turbopack (Next.js), and Rspack on cold-start, HMR and prod-build speed; ecosystem/plugin compatibility; framework coupling; realistic migration effort and gotchas. Verify: current stable status of Rolldown-powered Vite and Turbopack, and any published build-speed benchmarks (state methodology honestly). Sources: tool docs and release notes; reproducible benchmark posts. Distinct from the biome-vs-oxlint (linters) and TypeScript-7 (compiler) posts. End with a chooser by framework and project size.

topics.titleEn: Chaos Engineering for Small Teams: Start Small
topics.angle: how-to + safe experiments that surface failure before users do
topics.brief: Field-notes how-to bringing chaos engineering to small teams. Sections: the principle (hypothesis, small blast radius, learn); starting without fancy tooling (kill a pod, add latency, drop a dependency in staging); GameDays and steady-state metrics; graduating to tools (Litmus, chaos-mesh, AWS FIS); tying findings back to runbooks and alerts. Verify: the core chaos-engineering principles and typical starter experiments; blast-radius safety practices. Sources: Principles of Chaos Engineering; tool docs (Litmus, AWS FIS). Distinct from incident-response-for-small-teams and backups/DR posts. End with a first-GameDay checklist and a hypothesis template.
